FlowDefinitionData.description:
A {@link FlowDefinition} as models and configuration hold it

The statements are recursive: describing them in a JSON schema makes the schema generator explode, so they are
plain JSON there. {@link validateExpr } checks untrusted expressions.

params.description: Names of the flow parameters, in order

version.description: {@link flowVersion} of the definition, computed when missing

TaskOptions.description: Options of a task, and defaults of a flow

delay.description: Delay before the first retry (Duration syntax)

timeout.description: Maximum duration of one attempt (Duration syntax)

useSystem.description: Run the task as the system instead of the launcher

concurrency.description: Maximum number of tasks running at once on this replica

leaseDuration.description: Lease of a claimed task (ms), renewed while it runs

maxBufferedSignals.description: Maximum number of unexpired buffered signals per `(event, key)`: a new one past it is refused

maxContextSize.description: Maximum size of the journal and input of an instance (bytes of JSON)

maxSignalPayload.description: Maximum size of a signal payload (bytes of JSON)

pollInterval.description: Interval between two polls of the worker (ms)

signalTtl.description: How long a signal sent before any wait is kept (Duration syntax)

stopTimeout.description: Grace period of stop() for the running attempts (ms), then they are aborted and their outcome dropped

storedWorkflowRole.description: Role needed to create, update or delete a stored workflow

sweepInterval.description:
Interval of the recovery sweep (ms): an active instance not updated for this long and without a live task is
replayed

syncInterval.description: Without `syncPubSub`, interval between two reloads of the stored workflows (ms)

syncPubSub.description: PubSub service announcing the stored workflow changes to the other replicas

worker.description: Run the worker loop on this replica

Output.description:
A workflow defined at runtime: the same graph as a `.flow.ts` flow, stored as data

Saving validates the graph (expressions, statement kinds, operations, `useSystem`); the WorkflowService registers
it as the operation `name` and its crons, which run as the user who saved it last.

name.description: Flow id: the operation launching it

params.description: Names of the flow parameters, in order

updatedBy.description: User id of the last save: the identity of its crons

version.description: {@link flowVersion } of the graph, computed on save
